verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم صبوا فوق رأسه من عذاب الحميم

verse_text_english: “Taste this; you were so powerful, so honorable.”
verse_text_arabic: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
verse_text_transliterated: dhuq innaka anta l-ʿazīzu l-karīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: ذق إنك أنت العزيز الكريم

verse_text_english: This is what you used to doubt. The Righteous
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: inna hādhā mā kuntum bihi tamtarūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن هذا ما كنتم به تمترون

verse_text_english: The righteous will be in a secure position.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: inna l-mutaqīna fī maqāmin amīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن المتقين فى مقام أمين

verse_text_english: Enjoying gardens and springs.
verse_text_arabic: فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verse_text_transliterated: fī jannātin waʿuyūni
verse_text_arabic_clean: فى جنت وعيون

verse_text_english: Wearing velvet and satin; close to each other.
verse_text_arabic: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: yalbasūna min sundusin wa-is'tabraqin mutaqābilīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: يلبسون من سندس وإستبرق متقبلين

verse_text_english: We grant them beautiful spouses.
verse_text_arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: kadhālika wazawwajnāhum biḥūrin ʿīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: كذلك وزوجنهم بحور عين

verse_text_english: They receive therein all kinds of fruits, in perfect peace.
verse_text_arabic: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: yadʿūna fīhā bikulli fākihatin āminīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: يدعون فيها بكل فكهة ءامنين

verse_text_english: They never taste death therein, beyond the first death. He has spared them the retribution of Hell.
verse_text_arabic: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: lā yadhūqūna fīhā l-mawta illā l-mawtata l-ūlā wawaqāhum ʿadhāba l-jaḥīm
verse_subtitle_english: The Righteous Do Not Really Die*
verse_text_arabic_clean: لا يذوقون فيها الموت إلا الموتة الأولى ووقىهم عذاب الجحيم

verse_text_english: Such is the blessing from your Lord. Su
verse_text_arabic: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verse_text_transliterated: faḍlan min rabbika dhālika huwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: فضلا من ربك ذلك هو الفوز العظيم

verse_text_english: We have thus clarified it in your langua
verse_text_arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-innamā yassarnāhu bilisānika laʿallahum yatadhakkarūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإنما يسرنه بلسانك لعلهم يتذكرون

verse_text_arabic: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-ir'taqib innahum mur'taqibūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فارتقب إنهم مرتقبون
